top_choice_rationale: P001 is a mature, original and independently confirmed chain from proglucagon processing and the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide through incretin physiology and receptor biology to outcome-proven therapies in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease. A discovery-framed single prize to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov is coherent, though Habener's contested priority and the omission of Knudsen remain real weaknesses. No award is clearly worse than this prize.
